parameters.text: I didn't find a URL in your message. Forward me a link to capture, or use /help.

📚 *Knowledge Hub Bot*

*Commands:*
• Forward or paste a URL → captures the article as a clipping
• /list\_topics → shows your current topic notes
• /help → shows this message
• /cancel or /reset → clears the current session

*How it works:*
1\. Send me a link
2\. I fetch and summarise the article \(\~30 seconds\)
3\. A formatted clipping appears in your Obsidian vault under Clippings/Telegram/
4\. The clipping includes a summary, headlines, entities, and suggested topics
Forward me a link to capture, or use /help.
